description: Hellenic Air Force Noratlas erected in July 2018 at the Makedonitissa Tomb military cemetery at Engomi as the memorial to the aircraft and 33 men lost in Operation Niki on 22 July 1974. The true airframe is 52-128, construction number D030; it is painted as 52-133, the Noratlas actually shot down. OpenStreetMap carries a node named Noratlas at this position. Confirmed present on the ground on 3 October 2025.
